component.name: R2modman
component.summary: A simple and easy to use mod manager for many games using Thunderstore.

description.p: The official Flathub release of r2modman.
A simple and easy to use mod manager for many games using Thunderstore.

p.em: Some Flatpak overrides might be needed!

ul.li: You must ensure that the r2modman Flatpak has permissions to access the directory containing the game files for the game you want to mod. Standard game install locations, such as anywhere in the home directory or any mounted drives, are supported by default.
When using a Flatpak game launcher, like Flatpak Steam, you must ensure that it has access to your r2modman data directory. The default location is in ~/.var/app/io.github.ebkr.r2modman.
